name: NotificationNarrativeOrEnclosedFilePresenceRule
text: NotificationNarrative must be present or EnclosedFile must be present. Both may be present.

name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent1Guideline
text: It is recommended that, when present, PreviousInstructingAgent1 is the closest to the DebtorAgent in the payment chain.

name: PreviousInstructionAgent2Rule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructionAgent3Rule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

name: TransactionIdentificationPresenceRule
text: TransactionIdentification or UETR must be present. Both may be present

name: RejectReturnReasonRule
text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

name: StatusReasonRule
text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

name: RejectReturnReasonRule
text: TransactionStatus/RejectReturnReason must be absent or Transaction/RejectReturnReason must be absent.

name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

name: RejectReturnReasonRule
text: TransactionStatus/RejectReturnReason must be absent or Transaction/RejectReturnReason must be absent.

name: TrackerInformingPartyRule
text: GroupHeader/TrackerInformingParty or TrackerStatusAndTransaction/TrackerInformingParty must be present.

name: TrackerInformedPartyRule
text: GroupHeader/TrackerInformedParty must be absent or TrackerStatusAndTransaction/Transaction/TrackerInformedParty must be absent.

name: TrackerInformingParty2Rule
text: If GroupHeader/TrackerInformingParty is present, then TrackerStatusAndTransaction/TrackerInformingParty is not allowed.
